memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Gibeonites then sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: "Do not abandon your servants. Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us, because all the Amorite kings from the hill country have joined forces against us." So Joshua marched up from Gilgal with his entire army, including all the best fighting men. — Josh 10:6-7 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The Gibeonites are in desperate trouble, surrounded by five kings, and they send an urgent plea to Joshua: "Come up to us quickly and save us!" Remember, these are the people who had deceived Joshua just a short time before. He would have had every excuse to say, "You brought this on yourselves. Sort it out." But he does not. He honours his covenant with them and marches to their rescue with his entire army.

This is covenant faithfulness in action. Joshua had sworn to protect them, and even though they had tricked him into it, he kept his word. When they cried for help, he came — quickly, and with all his strength. He did not do the bare minimum; he committed everything to their defence.

There is a beautiful picture of God's own faithfulness here. The Gibeonites had nothing to offer and every reason to be abandoned, yet when they cried out, help came. God is like this with His people. When we cry to Him in our desperate need, He does not turn us away or remind us of how we got into the mess. He comes to save.

The gospel is the great cry-and-rescue story. We were helpless, surrounded by enemies we could not defeat, with no claim on God's help. Yet "everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved" (Rom 10:13). When we cry out to God through Christ, He does not abandon us. He comes with all His power to rescue those who belong to Him. What Joshua did for the Gibeonites, God does far more fully for us.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you hesitate to cry to God for help because of your own past failures?
2. When others in need cry to you, do you respond with faithful commitment?
3. How does God's readiness to rescue those who call on Him encourage you today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that when I cry out, You come to save, without holding my failures against me. Make me faithful, too, to help others who cry to me in need. Amen.
